description: This file defines minification functions for CSS and JavaScript code, and registers them in a table called 'minifiers'. It also requires an external file module and sets a metatable for 'minifiers'.

methods.name: minify_css
methods.description: Function that trims whitespace, appends semicolons, and removes comments and extraneous whitespace from CSS code to minify it.

methods.name: minify_js
methods.description: Function that removes comments, excess whitespace, and formats JavaScript code to minify it.
